pages.title: Skin Replacement
pages.text: DragIt lets you change your character's skin on the fly by dragging a skin file straight into the Minecraft window — no need to upload anything to your Mojang account!$(br2)Your new skin appears instantly, and other players on the same server will see it too.

pages.title: How to Use
pages.text: $(bold)1.$() Open your inventory (default key $(key)E$()).$(br2)$(bold)2.$() While the inventory is open, drag a $(bold).png$() skin file from your file explorer into the game window.$(br2)$(bold)3.$() Let go — your skin updates immediately.$(br2)$(note)The inventory screen must be open when you drop the file. Dropping while you're in the normal game view won't trigger a skin change.$()

pages.title: File Size Limit
pages.text: $(warn)Skin files must be 128×128 pixels or smaller.$()$(br2)Files larger than this will be rejected and a warning will appear in chat.$(br2)$(note)Standard Minecraft skins are 64×64 px (modern format) or 64×32 px (legacy format). Sticking to standard sizes gives the best results.$()

pages.title: Server Sync
pages.text: When you drop a skin, it is sent to the server and:$(br2)• Saved to the world so it persists across sessions$(br)• Shared with all currently online players$(br)• Automatically shown to any player who joins later$(br2)$(note)If your account is on the server blacklist, your skin will only be visible to yourself.$()
